text: 9月制造业大型企业PMI为50.6%，与上月持平，大型企业保持扩张；中型企业和小型企业PMI分别为49.7%和48.9%，比上月上升0.3个和1.0个百分点，景气度均有所回升。
text_en: In September, the PMI for large manufacturing enterprises was 50.6%, unchanged from the previous month, with large enterprises remaining in expansion; the PMIs for medium and small enterprises were 49.7% and 48.9%, respectively, up 0.3 and 1.0 percentage points from the previous month, with business conditions rebounding in both.
